chat.welcome: **Hi!** Ask me anything. Several people share this GPU — if someone is generating an image or video, your answer starts right after.
chat.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant. Answer in the language of the user.

image.prompt: 80s sports car cruising down a scenic coastal highway at sunset, shot on Kodak Ektar 100

video.prompt: A wide-angle panoramic view of a futuristic Japanese megacity at night, raining, wet reflective streets, slow camera dolly forward
video.note: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B · 24 fps. A 3 s 480p clip takes a few minutes on the 4090; 720p/5 s takes considerably longer. Other users' image jobs queue behind it.
